events.what_it_is: Credo Beauty's two-day SoHo reopening celebration with complimentary gifts for early guests, no-purchase raffles and a separate gift-with-purchase offer.
events.what_is_free: The first 150 guests each day receive a complimentary gift with no purchase necessary; onsite product raffles are also no-purchase. A separate event-exclusive gift requires a $100 in-store purchase.
events.caveats: Current event listings agree on Sept. 19–20 at Credo SoHo, 9 Prince St. RSVP is offered but explicitly not required and does not guarantee gift eligibility; complimentary gifts are first-come, first-served while supplies last. Credo's current store locator confirms the SoHo location.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM–7 PM; Sunday Sept. 20, 11 AM–6 PM. Walk-in public access. RSVP is optional and does not reserve a free gift; arrive early if the first-150 complimentary gift is the priority.

events.address: Magnolia Bakery, 401 Bleecker St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A launch pop-up for the Magnolia Bakery × LONDONTOWN nail-lakur collaboration at Magnolia Bakery's Bleecker Street shop.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 customers in line are advertised to receive a complimentary banana pudding dessert and a LONDONTOWN lakur product.
events.caveats: Magnolia Bakery's current site confirms the LONDONTOWN collaboration. Current NYC event listings agree on Saturday, Sept. 19, 11 AM–1 PM at 401 Bleecker St and describe the first-100 giveaway. No advance RSVP requirement is published; the giveaway is quantity-limited.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM–1 PM at Magnolia Bakery, 401 Bleecker St. Public walk-in; arrive before opening if the first-100 banana pudding + lakur giveaway is the priority.

events.address: Bloomingdale's SoHo, 504 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: A La Mer beauty-counter activation at Bloomingdale's SoHo pairing complimentary ice cream with a personalized Skin by La Mer experience and product sampling.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary ice cream plus a complimentary La Mer sample associated with the personalized counter experience, while supplies last.
events.caveats: NYC for FREE publishes Saturday, Sept. 19, 2–6 PM at 504 Broadway. Bloomingdale's Sept. 10 fall-events announcement independently confirms La Mer ice-cream-cart activations on Saturday Sept. 19, and Bloomingdale's current store information confirms 504 Broadway as its SoHo store. No RSVP requirement is published. Treat complimentary items as supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 2–6 PM at Bloomingdale's SoHo, 504 Broadway. Public walk-in; complimentary ice cream and beauty sampling are the actionable freebies.
